question: What do the FAA guidance and drone manuals say should happen when a connection is lost, and what do the available incident reports add or leave uncertain?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: lost link guidance and incident reports
intake.reason: FAA guidance and drone manuals on loss of connection; what incident reports add or leave uncertain

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance instructs to try to reestablish the control link, and if reestablishment fails, to start emergency or contingency procedures and discontinue flight until inspection. Drone manuals describe configurable failsafe actions on signal loss (RTH, land, or hover), with some models automatically initiating RTH and others offering conditions under which RTH or alternate paths are used; RTH can be triggered by user action, low battery, or signal loss, and some systems may maintain RTH even if RC is restored or switch to alternative routes if vision systems are unsuitable.

claims.text: When a loss of control link hazard occurs, FAA guidance says to 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.'
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
conditions: control link not synchronized or delayed

claims.text: The manual states: "The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover."
claims.quote: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover.

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action set to RTH

claims.text: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.
claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.

claims.text: If the lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.

claims.text: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).
claims.quote: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: If the C2 link is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
claims.quote: the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set
conditions: C2 link lost for more than 10 seconds

claims.text: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover and then execute the Signal Lost behavior after the disconnection message is shown in the app.

claims.text: Signal Lost behavior: Available options: Return to Home, Hover, Land.
